title: Dual Dimensionality for Local and Global Attention
abstract: arXiv:2606.18587v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Decoder-only Transformers compute attention over the KV cache of preceding tokens. Keys and Values are typically represented with the same dimensionality, regardless of their distance from the prediction target. In natural language, however, the next word is most strongly influenced by the immediately preceding tokens. We hypothesize that local and distant tokens impose asymmetric demands on representational capacity: local tokens are more critical for predicting immediate outputs and thus require richer representations, whereas distant tokens primarily serve as long-range memory, for which lower-dimensional representations may suffice. We formalize this idea as Distance-Adaptive Representation (DAR), which preserves full-dimensional representations within a local context window while assigning reduced-dimensional representations (e.g. 1/2 or 1/4 of the original dimensionality) to tokens beyond that window. translated_title: 面向局部与全局注意力的双重维度
translated_abstract: 仅解码器（Decoder-only）Transformer在先前token的KV缓存上计算注意力。Keys和Values通常以相同的维度表示，而无论它们与预测目标的距离远近。然而，在自然语言中，下一个词受紧邻的前序token影响最大。我们假设局部token与远距离token对表示能力的需求是不对称的：局部token对预测即时输出更为关键，因而需要更丰富的表示；而远距离token主要充当长程记忆，较低维度的表示可能已经足够。我们将这一想法形式化为距离自适应表示，它在局部上下文窗口内保留全维度表示，同时为窗口之外的token分配降维后的表示（例如原始维度的1/2或1/4）。在多个预训练……
tldr: 提出距离自适应表示（DAR），在局部上下文窗口内保留全维度KV表示，而对窗口外的远距离token仅使用1/2或1/4维度的表示，以反映局部与远距离token重要性不对称的特性。
en_tdlr: Proposes Distance-Adaptive Representation (DAR), which preserves full-dimensional KV representations within a local context window while assigning reduced-dimensional representations (1/2 or 1/4) to distant tokens, exploiting the asymmetric importance of local versus distant context in decoder-only Transformers.
